annotations.title: Find pages on page 2 of Google

description: Search Console queries where one of the user's sites ranks on page 2 of Google (average position 11 to 20), grouped by the page that ranks (paid plans, Search Console connected). Each page has its queries, impressions, clicks, an estimate of extra clicks at position 8, whether the title has the query words, and the actions to move it to page 1. Read-only.
